lines.zh: 贴着河底的软泥，我慢慢往前拱。
lines.en: I nose along the soft mud of the riverbed, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 冷水越深，我的鳞片越亮。
lines.en: The deeper the cold water, the brighter my scales shine.

lines.zh: 长吻先探路，石头挡不住我。
lines.en: My long snout goes first; no stone stops me.

lines.zh: 秋天到了，我该往湖心游。
lines.en: Autumn is here; I should swim toward the lake's heart.

lines.zh: 我沿着石缝一寸寸往前挪。
lines.en: I inch forward along the cracks between the stones.

lines.zh: 河底的冷水托着我，很安静。
lines.en: The cold river bottom carries me, and it is quiet.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的鳞甲很硬。
lines.en: Don't press too close; my plated scales are hard.

lines.zh: 冬季的水最清，我游得最远。
lines.en: Winter water is clearest, and that is when I travel farthest.

lines.zh: 我独自巡游，不需要同伴。
lines.en: I patrol alone; I do not need a school.

lines.zh: 泥里翻出的小虫，正好做午餐。
lines.en: Little worms turned up in the mud make a fine lunch.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，我又滑进深水。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail and I slide into deep water again.

lines.zh: 河水变冷，我的动作也慢下来。
lines.en: As the river cools, my movements slow down too.

lines.zh: 我在湖底绕了半圈，才回头。
lines.en: I circled half the lakebed before turning back.

lines.zh: 水草擦过腹鳍，我不在意。
lines.en: Weeds brush my belly fins; I don't really mind.

lines.zh: 我的长吻拱开一块卵石。
lines.en: My long snout pushes a cobble aside.

lines.zh: 冬天的河底很静，我慢慢巡。
lines.en: The winter riverbed is quiet. I patrol slowly.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，我越过一道深沟。
lines.en: One flick of the tail carries me over a deep trench.

lines.zh: 我沿着河湾的弧线游了半圈。
lines.en: I follow the curve of the river bend halfway around.

lines.zh: 河底的泥很软，我趴着不动。
lines.en: The riverbed mud is soft; I lie still on it.

lines.zh: 我等一片落叶沉下来。
lines.en: I wait for a fallen leaf to sink down.

lines.zh: 水声从远处传来，我听着。
lines.en: Water sounds come from far off, and I listen.

lines.zh: 鳞片上的泥，我慢慢抖掉。
lines.en: I shake the mud off my scales, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这里的冷，正合我意。
lines.en: The cold here suits me just fine.

lines.zh: 我把长吻埋进沙里歇一会。
lines.en: I bury my long snout in the sand to rest a while.

lines.zh: 水草在动，是水流，不是鱼。
lines.en: The weeds move — that is current, not fish.

lines.zh: 老骨头了，游一段就要停。
lines.en: Old bones: I swim a stretch, then stop.

lines.zh: 湖底的石头上长满了苔。
lines.en: Moss has grown all over the lakebed stones.

lines.zh: 我在数头顶经过的影子。
lines.en: I am counting the shadows passing overhead.

lines.zh: 没有同伴，也没什么不好。
lines.en: No school around, and that is not so bad.

lines.zh: 气泡一串串升上去，我看着。
lines.en: Bubbles rise in strings, and I watch them go.

lines.zh: 冬天快到了，水会更冷。
lines.en: Winter is coming; the water will turn colder still.

lines.zh: 河床的沟，我一条条都记得。
lines.en: I remember every groove in this riverbed.

lines.zh: 岸上的你，比水里的鱼更高。
lines.en: You on the bank stand taller than any fish down here.

lines.zh: 你的影子投进水里了。
lines.en: Your shape wavers on the riverbed beside me.

lines.zh: 手里那根竿，是钓我的吗？
lines.en: That rod in your hand — is it for me?

lines.zh: 我抬起长吻，看了你一眼。
lines.en: I lift my long snout and glance at you.

lines.zh: 别敲水面，我不喜欢响声。
lines.en: Don't slap the water; I dislike the noise.

lines.zh: 你把竿放下，我才抬头。
lines.en: You set the rod down, and only then do I look up.

lines.zh: 深水里的眼睛，也认得光。
lines.en: Even eyes in deep water know the light.

lines.zh: 你想装桶带我走？我太重。
lines.en: You want to bucket me? I am far too heavy.

lines.zh: 我转个身，让你看清鳞片。
lines.en: I turn so you can see my scales.

lines.zh: 你站久了，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: You stood a long while before I dared come close.

lines.zh: 鳞片挡住了大半，还剩一点疼。
lines.en: My scales took most of it; a little still stings.

lines.zh: 谁在敲我的背？
lines.en: Who is knocking on my back?

lines.zh: 我往深处沉，避开下一击。
lines.en: I sink deeper to avoid the next blow.

lines.zh: 硬鳞裂了一道细纹。
lines.en: A hairline crack runs through my hard scales.

lines.zh: 硬鳞护着，只伤了表层。
lines.en: My armor took it; only the surface is hurt.

lines.zh: 河底的泥被我搅起来了。
lines.en: I have churned the riverbed mud right up.

lines.zh: 我甩尾转身，看清了对手。
lines.en: I whip around and see my attacker.

lines.zh: 老鱼也会疼，只是不叫。
lines.en: Old fish feel pain too; we just don't cry out.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我退了半格。
lines.en: That one pushed me back half a block.

lines.zh: 水里有了铁味，是我的血。
lines.en: There is iron in the water now, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 泥里的虫子翻上来了，我闻到了。
lines.en: Worms are turning up from the mud; I smell them.

lines.zh: 那团饵沉得刚好，正对我胃口。
lines.en: That bait sinks just right — exactly my taste.

lines.zh: 我不急，先绕饵两圈。
lines.en: I won't rush; I'll circle the bait twice first.

lines.zh: 水底的香味，是从你那边来的。
lines.en: That smell on the bottom comes from your side.

lines.zh: 长吻碰到饵，我又缩了回来。
lines.en: My snout touches the bait, then pulls back.

lines.zh: 秋季的胃口，比夏天好得多。
lines.en: My autumn appetite is far better than in summer.

lines.zh: 再等一会，我就去咬。
lines.en: Give me a moment more, and I will bite.

lines.zh: 饵动了，我的长吻也动了。
lines.en: The bait moves, and so does my snout.

lines.zh: 冷水的鱼，吃得慢但吃得准。
lines.en: Cold-water fish eat slowly, but we eat true.

lines.zh: 我闻着那味道，忘了警惕。
lines.en: I follow that smell and forget to be wary.

lines.zh: 硬鳞撞上你，疼的是你。
lines.en: Hard scales hit you; you are the one who hurts.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，还是碰上了。
lines.en: I turned aside and still bumped into you.

lines.zh: 河底太窄，不是我故意的。
lines.en: The riverbed is narrow; it was not on purpose.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的鳞片没事。
lines.en: A knock like that does nothing to my scales.

lines.zh: 你退后些，我的吻很硬。
lines.en: Step back; my snout is hard as bone.

lines.zh: 我们错身而过，水都乱了。
lines.en: We pass each other and the water churns.

lines.zh: 别贴我这么近，我转身慢。
lines.en: Don't press so close; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把泥都扬起来了。
lines.en: That bump stirred the mud right up.

lines.zh: 我道歉，用尾巴轻轻拍水。
lines.en: I apologize with a soft slap of my tail.

lines.zh: 湖底的路，本来就只够一条鱼。
lines.en: The lakebed path is only wide enough for one fish.

lines.zh: 同类的影子，我认得那长吻。
lines.en: A shadow of my kind — I know that long snout.

lines.zh: 两条长吻并着，往同一个深潭。
lines.en: Two long snouts together, heading for the same deep pool.

lines.zh: 河底的卵，要藏在石缝里。
lines.en: The eggs belong in the cracks between stones.

lines.zh: 你也是从冷水里长大的吗？
lines.en: Did you grow up in cold water too?

lines.zh: 两条鲟鱼，慢慢绕成一个圈。
lines.en: Two sturgeon slowly circle into a ring.

lines.zh: 跟我来，深处的水更安稳。
lines.en: Follow me; the deep water is calmer.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片擦过你的，算是招呼。
lines.en: My scales brush yours — that counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 这条河养得起我们两个。
lines.en: This river can feed the both of us.

lines.zh: 水还凉，我们慢慢来。
lines.en: The water is still cold; let us take our time.

lines.zh: 明年秋天，还在这里见。
lines.en: Next autumn, meet me here again.

lines.zh: 沙里那颗螺壳，我衔起来。
lines.en: That shell in the sand — I pick it up.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我总会发现。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I always find it.

lines.zh: 泥里闪光，我就去挖。
lines.en: If it glints in the mud, I dig for it.

lines.zh: 这枚东西，我放在石缝里。
lines.en: I tuck this one into a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 嘴太小，只能含一颗。
lines.en: My mouth is small; I can hold only one.

lines.zh: 沉底的小石子，我也要看看。
lines.en: Even a sunken pebble deserves a look.

lines.zh: 水底的东西，都是我先看见。
lines.en: Things on the bottom — I see them first.

lines.zh: 我用长吻把它拨过来。
lines.en: I nudge it closer with my long snout.

lines.zh: 沉底的宝贝，归我了。
lines.en: Sunken treasure — that is mine now.

lines.zh: 捡完这颗，我还想再找。
lines.en: Once I have this one, I want to keep looking.

lines.zh: 那边水底有动静，我过去了。
lines.en: Something stirs on the bottom; I am going.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那条慢吞吞的小鱼。
lines.en: I have fixed on that slow little fish.

lines.zh: 石缝里探出的触须，是猎物。
lines.en: Tendrils poking from a crack — that is prey.

lines.zh: 水面落下的饵，我看见了。
lines.en: Bait dropping from the surface — I saw it.

lines.zh: 有东西在撞我的河床。
lines.en: Something keeps bumping against my riverbed.

lines.zh: 那股血味，从下游来的。
lines.en: That smell of blood comes from downstream.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着泥前进。
lines.en: I lower myself and creep along the mud.

lines.zh: 长吻已经对准了它。
lines.en: My long snout is already aimed at it.

lines.zh: 这条鱼跑不快，我挑它。
lines.en: That fish cannot run fast; I choose it.

lines.zh: 深水里的猎物，逃不出我的吻。
lines.en: Prey in deep water does not escape my snout.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我，再近一点。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed me; a little closer.

lines.zh: 我跟着它尾鳍的拍子挪。
lines.en: I time each beat of its trailing fin.

lines.zh: 水草挡住了，我绕过去。
lines.en: Weeds are in the way; I go around.

lines.zh: 它的影子在我的吻尖上。
lines.en: Its shadow rests on the tip of my snout.

lines.zh: 再等一拍，就扑上去。
lines.en: One more beat, then I lunge.

lines.zh: 别惊动它，水波会说话。
lines.en: Don't startle it; ripples talk.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片贴着泥，没有声响。
lines.en: My scales hug the mud without a sound.

lines.zh: 它往石缝里躲，我等着。
lines.en: It ducks into a crack; I wait.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我的吻够得到。
lines.en: At this range my snout can reach.

lines.zh: 它拐向石缝，我提前一步。
lines.en: It swings left, and I match the arc.

lines.zh: 长吻一顶，它翻了个身。
lines.en: One thrust of my snout and it flips over.

lines.zh: 我用硬鳞撞它的侧腹。
lines.en: I ram its flank with my plated scales.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，水都震了。
lines.en: My tail lashes out; the water shakes.

lines.zh: 别碰我的河床，我顶你。
lines.en: Don't touch my riverbed; I'll butt you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，够你退三步。
lines.en: That blow should push you back three steps.

lines.zh: 我的吻不尖，但很沉。
lines.en: My snout isn't sharp, but it is heavy.

lines.zh: 它被我压进泥里了。
lines.en: I have pinned it down into the mud.

lines.zh: 撞击之后，我慢慢退开。
lines.en: After the blow I back away, slowly.

lines.zh: 老鱼发火，力气不小。
lines.en: An old fish angry still hits hard.

lines.zh: 水里打架，我从不吃亏。
lines.en: In a fight underwater, I never come off worse.

lines.zh: 河水把我从深处推上来。
lines.en: The river pushes me up from the depths.

lines.zh: 这条河很冷，正合适。
lines.en: This river runs cold — just right.

lines.zh: 秋天的水，我又回来了。
lines.en: Autumn water; I have come back again.

lines.zh: 石缝里睁开眼，四周是泥。
lines.en: I open my eyes in a stone crack, mud all around.

lines.zh: 水流告诉我，这里是河群系。
lines.en: The current tells me this is river country.

lines.zh: 我甩甩尾，试着游第一段。
lines.en: I flick my tail and try my first stretch.

lines.zh: 这么大一条鱼，居然没声。
lines.en: A fish this big, and I make no sound.

lines.zh: 深水里有位置，我占下了。
lines.en: There is room in the deep; I claim it.

lines.zh: 先绕一圈，认认这处河湾。
lines.en: First a lap, to learn this river bend.

lines.zh: 我从泥里出来，鳞上还挂着沙。
lines.en: I rise from the mud with sand on my scales.

lines.zh: 水外的火，烫得我鳞片发白。
lines.en: Fire out of water scorches my scales pale.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬地上，长吻先着地。
lines.en: I hit hard ground snout-first.

lines.zh: 我离开了水，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: My gills work at nothing but water I no longer have.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，泥沙漫天。
lines.en: The blast flips me over in a cloud of silt.

lines.zh: 一根细东西扎进鳞缝里。
lines.en: Something thin has lodged between my scales.

lines.zh: 紫色的力气按住我，我动不了。
lines.en: Violet force pins me; I cannot move.

lines.zh: 饿得久了，我连泥里的虫都追不动。
lines.en: Starving this long, I can't even chase mud worms.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我全身一麻。
lines.en: The bolt hits the river and every scale goes numb.

lines.zh: 没有水的下方，我的鳃吸不到东西。
lines.en: Below me there is no water; my gills draw nothing.
